item: Row 276: per applied change file, its tag-change counts in the Field data member
summary: The osm-change-files member carries, per applied file and per country, the COUNT of osm_tag_changes rows by change (added/removed/modified) and of objects by how they took part (created/deleted/left their class/tags changed), joined on the file's own time and the country. Rows whose file stated no time are counted for the country and given to no file; two files with one time or a file with no time are null with a reason, never a share; a lane without the table says so, never 0. Never a key, a value or an object id. Read in the member's one lane session, nothing left open (held_for_swap test). The read-back prints the counts.
